intro: Cameroon has rainforest, savanna, mountains, beaches and the edge of the Sahel.

chapters.title: Africa in miniature
text: Mount Cameroon, an active volcano at 4,040 m, is West Africa's highest peak. The south has rainforest, the centre plateaus, and the north savanna reaching Lake Chad.
In 1986 Lake Nyos released a cloud of carbon dioxide that killed about 1,700 people.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Debundscha, at the foot of Mount Cameroon, is one of the wettest places on Earth.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake in a volcano's crater.
